notes.key_invariant: Section 3.3: when P13 adjusts evidence the prior P14 confirmation is invalidated. Enforced three ways - confirming without a bundle digest raises, recording an evidence change marks prior confirmations not current and returns their ids, and validating against a mismatched digest fails even if the invalidation path was skipped. The third matters because it means a missed invalidation cannot let a stale confirmation pass.
